about.title: About Me
about.description:
I am a State Engineer in Artificial Intelligence & Data Science with a Master's degree in Computer Science from ESTIN (Béjaïa, Algeria), and a full-stack developer focused on business applications.

Since 2023 I have delivered web platforms for real clients: travel booking, e-commerce, invoicing, loan and social fund management, and telemedicine. I handle the whole cycle, from requirements and database design to the interface and production release, and I founded my own studio, Celerix Studio, to work with companies directly.

I care about clean architecture, reliability and software that people actually use. I work in French, English and Arabic.

items.title: Design of a smart connected health platform (IoT + AI)
items.description: Design of a smart connected health platform: teleconsultation, connected devices (IoT) and AI (deep learning) for clinical risk, anomalies and prescription support. Lead developer.
items.stack: Next.js · Express · WebRTC · PostgreSQL · Python · PyTorch
items.details: Final-year engineering project: design of a smart connected health platform (IoT + AI), where I was lead developer. sections.title: Artificial intelligence and deep learning
sections.intro: A Python microservice (FastAPI) hosts three models loaded at startup. The Node.js API calls it with a 10-second timeout; if the service is unavailable, saving a measurement or a record is not blocked.

items.name: Clinical risk prediction
items.text: A CamemBERT transformer (12 layers, 768 dimensions) fine-tuned on French medical notes classifies a clinical text as low, medium or high risk, with a confidence score and a recommendation. The analysis runs automatically whenever a medical record is created, and a high risk triggers a notification to the doctor. Patients can also run a prediction from their dashboard, with a history.

items.name: Medication recommendation
items.tech: Deep learning · Sentence embeddings · Nearest neighbours · Logistic regression
items.text: The diagnosis and symptoms are converted into vectors by a multilingual embedding model (MiniLM). A search over similar clinical cases (360 cases) suggests medications ranked by confidence score, along with the similar cases that justify the suggestion, and a classifier predicts the specialty. Doctor-only feature, used as prescription support.

items.name: Anomaly detection on connected devices
items.tech: Machine learning · Isolation Forest · Personalised z-score
items.text: Three Isolation Forest models (heart rate, blood pressure, SpO₂) spot outliers, and a z-score computed on each patient's own history (from 10 measurements) personalises detection: a value that is normal for the population may be abnormal for a given patient. Each measurement gets an anomaly score from 0 to 1 and a recommendation; thresholds set by the doctor also generate alerts and notifications.

sections.title: An automated production pipeline
sections.intro: Three steps chained by commands: capture a project's screens, compose the visuals, then produce them.

items.name: Capture
items.text: A sheet per project describes the pages to photograph. One command logs into the protected areas (doctor, patient, administration), captures each page in high-definition desktop and in mobile, and stores the images with a summary.

items.name: Compose
items.text: The compositions read these captures: vertical videos with a 3D scene, a guided website tour, posts and covers. All texts and images are set in Remotion Studio.

items.name: Produce
items.text: MP4 (H.264) rendering with generated voice-over and sound effects, loudness measurement, and export of posts as PNG or JPEG and of covers in two themes.
